hints.title: Range Updates on Circular Alphabet
hints.text: Each shift range [start, end] with forward direction (+1) or backward direction (-1) updates a range of indices.

hints.title: Difference Array Formulation
hints.text: Apply difference array increments: diff[start] += delta and diff[end + 1] -= delta where delta is +1 or -1.

hints.title: Prefix Sum Accumulation
hints.text: Compute running prefix sums of diff to obtain the net shift count for each character, applying modulo 26.

hints.title: Difference Array Prefix Sum Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def shiftingLetters(self, s: str, shifts: list[list[int]]) -> str:
        n = len(s)
        diff = [0] * (n + 1)
        for start, end, direction in shifts:
            delta = 1 if direction == 1 else -1
            diff[start] += delta
            diff[end + 1] -= delta
        cur = 0
        res = []
        for i in range(n):
            cur += diff[i]
            shift = (ord(s[i]) - ord('a') + cur) % 26
            res.append(chr(ord('a') + shift))
        return "".join(res)
```

complexity.notes: Linear difference array range updates and prefix scan.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Updating each range character by character costs O(n * q) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Uses line sweep difference array to process range updates in linear time.
